# Agent Wallet

> AI agents that live on any NFT you own (any NEP-171 collection) with their own budget, and limits a NEAR smart contract enforces: cap per action, cap per day, allowed payees or one market. The agent's key can only pay or buy inside those limits; it can never withdraw, change limits or move the NFT. Every blocked attempt is logged on chain. Sell the NFT and the agent stops. NEAR testnet only, test tokens, no real money.

Live app: https://near-nft-wheat.vercel.app/agents (a real Agent Wallet without a wallet: https://near-nft-wheat.vercel.app/agents?as=nifelst.testnet).

Any MCP client (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) can drive an agent with a one-file server that plain `node` runs, no install:

```
node -e "fetch('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nielslecodeur/near_nft/keepers/public/mcp/agent-wallet.mjs').then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>require('fs').writeFileSync('agent-wallet.mjs',t))"
claude mcp add agent-wallet-demo -- node "$PWD/agent-wallet.mjs" --demo
```

`--demo` drives the public demo agent (seat 9, 1 USDC per payment, 2 USDC a day, one allowed payee). `--key <agent-key.json>` drives your own agent; the key file comes from the app ("Import an agent"). MCP tools: list_agents, agent_status, received_agents (agents waiting on NFTs an account holds, with the command that installs their skill), list_market, pay, buy, pause. A refused action is normal: report the contract's reason. Never ask a user for a full-access key or seed phrase.

Contracts (no admin key): `agents-v2.everkeep-dev-mw0weth5.testnet` for new agents (on-chain profile and track record that follow the NFT, flood-proof log, optional budget for the next owner) and `agents-v1.everkeep-dev-mw0weth5.testnet` for earlier ones. Seats are named by key: "9" is v1 seat 9, "v2-3" is v2 seat 3. USDC: `3e2210e1184b45b64c8a434c0a7e7b23cc04ea7eb7a6c3c32520d03d4afcb8af`. Buyer market: `keepers-v2.everkeep-dev-mw0weth5.testnet`. Agent market (sell a v2 agent with its NFT and, optionally, its budget; the seller is paid only if the promised budget is still in the agent after the NFT moved, otherwise the buyer is refunded): `agent-market-v1.everkeep-dev-mw0weth5.testnet`. Ids and amounts are strings; Payer amounts are USDC units (6 decimals), Buyer amounts yoctoNEAR.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nielslecodeur/near_nft/blob/keepers/AGENTS.md): full guide: contract methods with arguments and deposits, refusal reasons, views, events, near-api-js example, runner, developer commands
- [Design and threat model](https://github.com/nielslecodeur/near_nft/blob/keepers/docs/agents-design.md): seat model, who can call what, what happens when the NFT changes hands, tests

## Machine-readable

- [Contract ABI v2](/abi/agents-v2.json), [v1](/abi/agents.json) and [agent market](/abi/agent-market.json): NEAR ABI 0.4, generated by `cargo near abi` from the deployed sources
- [Runner API](/openapi/runner.json): OpenAPI 3.1 for the runner (NEP-413 sign-in, jobs, pay/buy/pause, and on the hosted runner private skills gated by an NFT: only its current holder can read `/gated/<nft_contract>/<token_id>`)
- [MCP server, one file](/mcp/agent-wallet.mjs): `node agent-wallet.mjs --help`

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/nielslecodeur/near_nft/tree/keepers): branch `keepers`; the Agent Wallet is `contracts/agents`, `src/keepers`, `scripts/agent-*`; other folders belong to an earlier project
- [Public demo agent key](https://github.com/nielslecodeur/near_nft/blob/keepers/demo/agent-key.json): published on purpose, agent_pay only
